sfp_accounts.notes: Primary smoke path is e-mail identity lookup; DOMAIN_NAME is secondary.

sfp_countryname.notes: Validates on scraped page text, not domain root scan.

sfp_crossref.notes: Module watches external URLs; INTERNET_NAME seed was wrong nugget.

sfp_dnsbrute.notes: watchedEvents() is conditional; defaults include DOMAIN_NAME. Validated on DOMAIN_NAME.

sfp_dnscommonsrv.notes: SRV brute-force is domain-scoped; seed registered on DOMAIN_NAME.

sfp_dnsneighbor.notes: watchedEvents is IP_ADDRESS only; NETBLOCK_MEMBER seed was invalid.

sfp_dnszonexfer.notes: watchedEvents is PROVIDER_DNS; zone transfer follows NS discovery.

sfp_hosting.notes: ipcat lookup is IP-scoped; TARGET_WEB_CONTENT seed was wrong nugget.

sfp_junkfiles.notes: Crawler emits LINKED_URL_INTERNAL; INTERNET_NAME seed was wrong nugget.

sfp_names.notes: Name extraction runs on page content; EMAILADDR priority was misleading.

sfp_phone.notes: Phone extraction from HTML; PHONE_NUMBER route was wrong for smoke.

sfp_similar.notes: Similar-domain search validated on hostname input.

sfp_social.notes: Social links parsed from external URLs.

sfp_tldsearch.notes: TLD permutation search is domain-scoped; allow extended timeout.

sfp_tool_retirejs.notes: retire.js validated on internal page URL.
